'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**[[July 2023 Jenin incursion]]
***Eight [[Palestinians]] are killed and more than 50 others are injured when [[Israeli Defense Forces|Israeli soldiers]] storm the [[Jenin refugee camp]] in the occupied [[West Bank]]. The [[Israeli Air Force]] also launches [[airstrike]]s during the night. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/7/3/two-palestinians-killed-as-israel-attacks-west-bank-city-of-jenin (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[2022–2023 Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure]]
***[[Russia]] launches [[drone warfare|drone attacks]] on [[Sumy]], [[Ukraine]], killing two people and injuring 19 others. In response to the attack, [[President of Ukraine|Ukrainian President]] [[Volodymyr Zelenskyy]] calls for a major upgrade of anti-aircraft defences. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/one-killed-russian-drone-strike-northern-ukrainian-city-kyiv-says-2023-07-03/ (Reuters)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[Censorship in Vietnam]]
**[[Vietnam]] announces that it will ban the upcoming American film ''[[Barbie (film)|Barbie]]'' over a scene showing a map displaying the [[nine-dash line]] in the [[South China Sea]], which Vietnam does not recognize. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/vietnam-bans-barbie-movie-over-south-china-sea-map-2023-07-03/ (Reuters)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[India]]n [[oil refiner]]s start payments for Russian oil imports in [[Chinese yuan]] as an alternative to the [[US dollar]] due to the [[International sanctions during the Russian invasion of Ukraine|sanctions against Russia]]. [https://www.reuters.com/business/energy/india-refiners-start-yuan-payments-russian-oil-imports-sources-2023-07-03/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Four people are injured in an explosion at a building in [[Minato, Tokyo|Minato]], [[Tokyo]], [[Japan]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/explosion-downtown-tokyo-building-four-reported-injured-2023-07-03/ (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Georgia–Ukraine relations]]
**Volodymyr Zelenskyy requests [[Georgia (country)|Georgian]] [[ambassador]] [[Gela Dumbadze]] to return home within 48 hours to negotiate imprisoned former [[President of Georgia|Georgian president]] and [[Ukrainian nationality law|Ukrainian citizen]] [[Mikheil Saakashvili]]'s transfer to a [[Healthcare in Ukraine|Ukrainian clinic]] due to Saakashvili's declining health. [https://www.scmp.com/news/world/europe/article/3226449/health-fears-georgias-jailed-ex-leader-mikheil-saakashvili-after-tv-footage (AFP via ''SCMP'')]
*[[International sanctions during the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**The [[National Agency on Corruption Prevention|Ukrainian National Agency on Corruption Prevention]] adds British [[Conglomerate (company)|conglomerate]] [[Unilever]] to its "international sponsors of war" list, claiming that Unilever's Russian operations indirectly fund the invasion. [https://www.wionews.com/world/ukraine-places-unilever-on-international-sponsors-of-war-list-triggers-protests-in-london-611567 (AFP via WION)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2023 Kingsessing, Philadelphia shooting]]
**Five people are killed and two others are injured in a [[Spree killer|shooting spree]] in [[Philadelphia]], [[Pennsylvania]], [[United States]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-66061204 (BBC News)]
*[[2023 Fort Worth shooting]]
**Three people are killed and eight others are injured in a [[mass shooting]] at a festival in [[Fort Worth, Texas|Fort Worth]], [[Texas]], United States. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us/shooting-texas-leaves-least-3-dead-8-wounded-cnn-2023-07-04/ (Reuters)]
*A court in [[Iran]] [[sentence (law)|sentences]] prominent writer and [[human rights]] activist [[Golrokh Ebrahimi Iraee]] to five years in prison. Iraee has been detained since September 2022. [https://iranwire.com/en/news/118124-iranian-prominent-activist-iraei-jailed-for-five-years/ (IranWire)]
*[[Nicaragua]]n [[Bishops in the Catholic Church|bishop]] [[Rolando José Álvarez Lagos]], imprisoned in February for refusing exile to the United States with 222 [[political prisoner]]s, is temporarily released but immediately rearrested, amidst conflicting reports and tensions [[Holy See–Nicaragua relations|between]] the [[Government of Nicaragua|Nicaraguan government]] and the [[Holy See]]. [https://www.manilatimes.net/2023/07/07/world/nicaraguan-bishop-alvarez-released-from-jail-rearrested/1899449 (AFP via ''The Manila Times'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2024 Senegalese presidential election]]
**[[President of Senegal|President]] [[Macky Sall]] announces that he will not seek re-election for a third term in next year's election. [https://www.lemonde.fr/en/international/article/2023/07/03/senegalese-president-macky-sall-says-he-won-t-seek-a-third-term-in-2024-elections-after-protests_6042308_4.html (''Le Monde'')]
